name: Muneeb Ur Rehman
title: Senior .NET Backend & Full-Stack Engineer
location: Pakistan (UTC+5) · Remote, works across US, EU and Gulf hours
availability: Available now for remote full-time, part-time and contract work
summary: Senior .NET engineer with 6+ years building data-heavy ERP, finance, payroll and U.S. healthcare systems. I design and ship ASP.NET Core APIs, PostgreSQL and SQL Server data models, background jobs and Angular or React front ends where correctness and auditability matter, and I own the work from domain modeling through deployment and production support. I currently lead a team of five developers. I also build and ship my own products: Nivora, a live expense-splitting app for web and Android, and Arqentivo, a self-hosted POS and online-store platform on .NET 10, Angular and PostgreSQL.

services.name: Backend APIs & services
services.description: ASP.NET Core APIs, background processing with Hangfire, authentication and role-based access, integrations with ERP and third-party systems.

services.name: Database performance & data pipelines
services.description: PostgreSQL and SQL Server query tuning, N+1 fixes, bulk loads with binary COPY, staging and upserts, cross-database sync and migrations.

services.name: Full-stack business apps
services.description: End-to-end .NET + Angular (or React) features: data model, API, UI, Docker deployment and CI/CD.

services.name: Legacy modernization
services.description: Moving FoxPro, VB and older .NET systems to modular, multi-tenant web platforms with audit trails and safe migration plans.

highlights: Implemented the declarative .report capability in a model-driven ERP, so financial and operational reports are defined in metadata rather than hand-coded.
Optimized .model parsing and data-retrieval paths, removing N+1 entity-loading patterns from core business queries.
Built accounting journal services, reporting queries and dashboards, plus financial and operational integrity checks.
Shipped targeted React UI changes and took part in architecture discussions, code reviews and production troubleshooting.
Modernized U.S. healthcare claims, billing, patient-management and accounts workflows.
Tuned SQL queries and automated invoicing, PDF generation and email notifications.
Worked directly with U.S. stakeholders on HIPAA-sensitive features with role-based access and secure data handling.
Developed healthcare payment and reimbursement workflows on ASP.NET and Azure SQL.
Implemented Azure Functions-based background processing, Power BI / RDLC reporting and role-based authorization.
Led a team of developers delivering in-house HRMS, payroll, attendance and reporting systems.
Integrated Microsoft Dynamics GP finance processes with in-house systems through secure APIs and SQL Server reporting.
Connected biometric attendance devices and kept legacy Visual FoxPro / VB systems integrated with newer .NET services.

projects.name: Nivora
projects.description: Expense-splitting and personal finance app for friends, roommates, families and small businesses. Web and Android, free to start.
highlights: Equal or custom bill splits, people ledgers with pay/receive, and separate books for personal and business money.
Recurring bills with reminders, transfers, account and cash tracking, notes and a Kanban planner.
Receipt attachments with OCR; one .NET API serving the Angular web app and the Flutter Android app.

projects.name: Arqentivo: POS & online store platform
projects.description: Self-hosted retail platform that puts POS, back office and online store in one product, so a shop needs neither Shopify nor WordPress. One .NET 10 engine serves the Angular POS, admin and storefront apps.
highlights: Multi-company, multi-store tenancy with row-level isolation, JWT and refresh tokens, and role-based permissions.
Inventory with per-product batch and expiry tracking (FIFO / FEFO), purchasing, customer credit ledgers, COD and courier hand-off.
Online store with CMS, SEO center, coupons, variants and reviews, plus a storefront SDK and ZIP publishing (preview, publish, rollback) for merchant-built sites.
One isolated Docker stack per shop on PostgreSQL and S3 object storage; about 2,300 automated tests, including PostgreSQL integration tests in CI.

projects.name: Fonaza: custom storefront on Arqentivo
projects.description: Storefront for a phone-accessories shop, built as an Arqentivo custom site that talks to the shop only through the storefront SDK.
highlights: Browser cart with server-calculated totals, guest order tokens and SDK-managed customer sign-in.
Design tokens for type, color and spacing; packaged as a ZIP that the shop uploads and publishes.

projects.name: Colony HR: payroll modernization
projects.description: Multi-company HR and payroll platform replacing a Visual FoxPro, VB6 and SQL Server estate that covers 10K+ employees across six or more company databases.
highlights: Leading the build: modular boundaries, schema-per-tenant PostgreSQL, granular permissions and approval workflows.
Attendance, leave, overtime, loans and payroll logic with audit history and payroll integrity controls.
Running in internal UAT; historical migration and production cutover are next.

projects.name: Colossys: industrial data sync
projects.description: Industrial monitoring and manufacturing analytics platform.
highlights: Optimized machine-data synchronization to process 100K+ records within minutes.
Configurable batching, PostgreSQL binary COPY, staging tables, transactional upserts and SQL Server bulk operations.
Cut unnecessary logging and database overhead; built reporting and analytics features.

projects.name: Tuli: declarative ERP reporting
projects.description: Model-driven ERP and property-management platform built by a team around .model, .report and .workflow files.
highlights: Owned the .report capability for financial and operational reporting.
Accounting journals, dashboards, query optimization and data-integrity checks.

projects.name: DbSync
projects.description: .NET CLI for SQL Server and PostgreSQL schema discovery, diff-based migrations and configurable full or append synchronization.
